decision: Conservative interpretation of the user's prohibition on automatically running methods involving real transaction commit or parent.run. T1-T11 call the real begin_and_commit implementation with synthetic identities and method-local TemporaryDirectory roots; despite their isolated paths, no method was executed in this step.
